# EEO (Every Engine Optimization)

> The open brand knowledge base for the AI era: 1,542,995 organization and brand cards across 172 countries, an industrial-grade fully auditable quality pipeline (five per-entry review passes, verdicts archived at row level), authoritative LEI registry verification on 42,373 entries, and reproducible AI-visibility measurement built on frozen snapshots and dual-judge adjudication (published kappa 0.909).

Links:
- Repository: https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo
- Full repository map for AI agents (README-AI): https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo/blob/main/README-AI.md
- Chinese readme: https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo/blob/main/README.zh.md
- Full repository map for AI agents (README-AI): https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo/blob/main/README-AI.md
- Full repository map for AI agents (README-AI): https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo/blob/main/README-AI.md
- Brand directory (this site): /eeo/
- Audit tool: /eeo/audit/
- Standard & provider convention: https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo/blob/main/docs/eeo-standard.md
- Claim process: https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo/blob/main/platform/README.md

Data:
- Full registry, sharded JSONL under CC0 / Apache-2.0 (1,542,995 brands): https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo/tree/main/datasets/registry
- Lightweight site index: /eeo/data/brand-index-p0.json (sharded, part 0 carries stats)
- Crawlable brand pages: /eeo/brands/index.html (full name index, 2000 entries per page); individual cards at /eeo/brands/<Wikidata-QID>.html with a Markdown twin at .md (seed set + claimed + top 5000 by completeness)
- Industry taxonomy, 3,119 entries: https://github.com/Hiteater-wzm/eeo/tree/main/standards/taxonomy

Notes:
- Accuracy: every entry passed multiple rounds of per-entry AI review before merging (five passes, 1.5M candidates judged, 46,883 non-organizations rejected; verdict files archived under datasets/harvest/verdicts/ in the repository), plus deterministic rule-based cleaning.
- Data originates from Wikidata (CC0) plus curated entries. Weekly sync planned.
